jobs.description:
Part of your life. Part of tomorrow.

We make life easier, safer and greener, with technology that achieves more, consumes less and is accessible to everyone. Microelectronics from Infineon is the key to a better future. Efficient use of energy, environmentally-friendly mobility and security in a connected world we solve some of the most critical challenges that our society faces while taking a conscientious approach to the use of natural resources. We seek 1 Staff Specialist Product Management High Voltage SiC Discretes (f/m/div) 

HRC1854084

Your role

You have already gained experience in product management and are looking for a career opportunity where you can shape the commercial success of a power semiconductor portfolio? In this role, you will drive pricing and forecasting activities, define market introduction plans, and develop go-to-market activities for our 750 V/1200 V on-board charger (OBC) and DC/DC converter product portfolio. If you enjoy combining market insights with semiconductor expertise and collaborating in an international environment, this is the right opportunity for you.

Key responsibilities in your new role

 * Develop and evaluate pricing and structures for released products within the 750 V/1200 V OBC and DC/DC converter product portfolio

 * Provide product forecasts and define the final market introduction plan during the commercialization phase of the product portfolio

 * Develop market introduction and go-to-market activities at product level

 * Support the development and execution of product and production strategies, including optimization programs, product transfers, and discontinuation processes

Your profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

 * A degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Economics, Business Administration or a related discipline

 * At least 3 years of professional experience, preferably in product management within the semiconductor industry

 * Knowledge of semiconductors, especially power electronics, is an advantage

 * An energetic mindset combined with a structured and self-organized working style

 * Excellent English communication and presentation skills; German is an advantage

We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group G (https://www.feei.at/leistungen/informations-service/mindestlohne-und-gehalter). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.
